notes.title: UPDATE 1.2, HUGE REVAMP!
notes.notes:
[h1]THE BIGGEST UPDATE, BEFORE CHAPTER 2 RELEASE, IS OUT!! [/h1]

Here is the list of updates, but I also created a [url=https://youtu.be/ct3RhNyWqUQ]Youtube video[/url] with the main updates, since I know how much TikTok ruined y'all's attention span ( ≖‿ ≖ ):

[list]
[*] A lot of new content with Hitomi, including two new endings for her—a true ending and a bad ending—as well as achievements for each. With this update, you can get closer to her, learn her heartbreaking backstory, and explore her past relationships!
[*] The Hitachiin brothers' dialogue has been revamped, making them even more mischievous than before 😈!
[*] New battle and menu UI!
[*] New level system for enemies! Battles have also received some quality-of-life updates, such as the ability to skip the fight/escape section after every turn (this annoyed a lot of people), moving enemies, and visual enemy selection!
[*] Difficulty changer!
[*] Victory aftermath has been revamped and is now more visually appealing and informative.
[*] New menu poses for Yuta and Hitomi!
[*] New game over screens!
[*] Revamped options screen with new useful selections, such as keybind settings and message speed!
[*] Dialogue log! You can now check it in case you missed something!
[*] Revamped some of the dialogue!
[*] And, as always, bug fixes! (Do I even have to say that anymore?)
[/list]

Even if you played the game before, replaying it will feel like a whole new experience, so please give it a try:>!! ( Also press "New Game", because Prologue will be broken if you use "Continue" )

Please enjoy the update and join our 60+ members [url=https://discord.gg/uPxKZQZVxw]Discord[/url] to discuss it, get early access to content and interact with a welcoming community!

notes.title: CURSED ORDER V. 1.1 !
notes.notes:
THIS IS THE BIGGEST UPDATE, SINCE THE PROLOGUE AND CHAPTER 1 RELEASE! 

-All the sprites have been replaced with new and original ones!
-Added an introductory tutorial to the combat system, by Hitomi.
-Updated some of the visuals.
-Improved dialogue's writing and its flow.
-Bug fixes

( This will also include all the smaller patches that happened in the last month ).

-[b]The game's writing has been significantly updated and revamped.[/b]
-Added short cutscenes to indicate where the prologue and chapter 1 begin.
-Made some play-quality changes.
-Some Cursed Order soldiers took a break so the chase scene is easier. ( just negotiate guys!! )
-Minor bug fixes.


In conclusion, the writing and original sprites are the biggest changes from the game's release.
I can proudly announce that the game is in a way better situation than it was only 3 months ago, when the game was released. Those months were hard, but I'm happy that we got this out to you.

Anyways this is one of the last updates before the chapter 2 release. So stay tuned.

Upcoming updates:

-Cutscene for the carrot minigame.
-A major addition to the elf's dialogue about his past and possibly a cutscene.
AND 
CHAPTER 2 WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!

Since you scrolled this far, here are some sneak peeks about chapter 2!!
-It will be the longest chapter so far ( possibly longer than the current ones combined )
-It takes place in a cavern city based under Astaria's kingdom, for unfortunate ones to live and rot.
-Cannibals!!!!!
-And oh! There will be a giant pile of bodies ^w^!!
